class.name: MaszynaFizManager
class.brief_description: The vehicles' FIZ files as their descriptions, each read once.
class.description: A [code].fiz[/code] read into its vehicle's description - a [VehicleController] with its components, which a vehicle is built of a copy of - and kept on disk: a scenery repeats the same file across many trainset entries, and parsing it is the expensive part. An entry is read again when its file changes (its modification time - an included file's is not seen), the reader's format does or the wipers the game's patch gives the file do. The reader is the FIZ parser, handed in by the plugin's runtime ([method set_description_reader]).

method.name: load_description
method.description: Returns the vehicle the [code].fiz[/code] of [param data_path]/[param fiz_filename] in the game's data describes. [param wipers] - the wipers the game's patch gives a [code].fiz[/code] of no [code]WiperList:[/code], none without a patch.

method.name: load_description_at
method.description: Returns the vehicle the [code].fiz[/code] at [param fiz_path] describes, with [param wipers] as [method load_description]; null without a reader.

method.name: set_description_reader
method.description: Sets what reads a [code].fiz[/code] into its description - [code](fiz_path: String, wipers: RailVehicleWipers) -> VehicleController[/code] - and [param format_version], the version of what it builds, raised whenever the parser changes it.
